raw_text: The Ministry of Defence on Saturday confirmed that an audio clip circulating on social media purporting to be the Defence Minister discussing classified troop movements is entirely fabricated. 'The audio is AI-generated and does not represent any real conversation,' the MoD said in an official statement. Independent spectral analysis revealed synthetic voice artifacts including uniform pitch modulation and absence of natural breathing patterns consistent with AI voice cloning technology.
clean_text: Ministry of Defence confirmed leaked audio clip is AI-generated fabrication. Official statement and independent spectral analysis revealed synthetic voice artifacts including uniform pitch and absent breathing patterns.
